overview.description: The ProShares Ultra Health Care (RXL) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the S&P Health Care Select Sector index. The fund provides 2x leveraged exposure to a cap-weighted index of US health care companies. RXL was launched on Jan 30, 2007 and is issued by ProShares.
